what_this_is_en: Every substance named on every line, read a second time and asked only that: not roles, not quantities, not whether it matters. `specific` names one substance you could draw; `generic` refers to a substance without naming one, and is counted apart because `the catalyst` is sometimes an anaphor and sometimes the finding.
verified_en: Every span below was checked to be a literal substring of the English rendering of the line it is filed under before this file was written, using the same Source the verification engine uses. A span that is not on the line fails the build rather than reaching a reviewer.
how_read_en: Six readers, each given a disjoint range of lines as plain text and nothing else. None of them saw any extraction output: this pass was run before A1 existed, so it could not have been derived from the records it is used to measure. The reader is a language model, the same family that produced the vision and extraction passes, so where it and the extraction agree that agreement is weaker evidence than it looks.
